blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven V156 renders: three local pleat cycles per panel still read as broad flared faces with shallow irregular ridges; the repeated pleat rhythm and hem cadence are not distinct at product scale.
The crouch and sit renders still expose broad, angular upper-thigh shell edges at the front opening; the shell does not follow bent thigh contours closely enough to claim fit or adequate coverage.
Front, side, back and arm-cross views still show uneven pinched facets across the torso/waist and visible discontinuities where the jacket meets the skirt; V155 torso fairing remains insufficient.
The prone pose remains a rigid horizontal overlap of limbs and skirt panels without plausible drape; required pose evidence remains visually unacceptable.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
